name: git-commit-ai
description: Generate git commit messages using any OpenAI-compatible AI model

gitcommitai.apiEndpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint URL (e.g., https://api.openai.com/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama)

gitcommitai.apiKey.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible service. Leave empty for local services like Ollama.

gitcommitai.model.description: Model name to use for commit message generation (e.g., gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, llama3, deepseek-chat)

gitcommitai.temperature.description: Temperature for generation. Lower values produce more predictable output.

gitcommitai.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the generated commit message.

gitcommitai.customInstructions.description: Custom instructions appended to the system prompt for commit message generation (e.g., 'Use conventional commits format', 'Write in Chinese')

gitcommitai.systemPrompt.description: Override the default system prompt entirely. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.
